name: Okubo
tagline: Shinjuku in 3 minutes and Shibuya in 13 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where JR East run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 28 minutes to Otemachi, 3 minutes to Shinjuku, 13 minutes to Shibuya and 34 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 38.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.9 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 38.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30.3 m to 38.2 m, a difference of 7.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 18 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 広恵会春山外科病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is JCHO 東京山手メディカルセンター, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local).
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
